get_transforms_train_val: build a python module to get train and val image transforms for ImageNet with full augmentation pipeline
Resize_class: create a custom Resize transform that resizes images to a target size without cropping by largest side
Lighting_class: build a PCA jitter transform that applies random lighting augmentation to image tensors using eigenvalues and eigenvectors
Bound_class: create a tensor clamping transform that bounds pixel values between a lower and upper threshold
get_transforms_backbone: build a python module to get image transforms with custom mean and std for pnasnet5large or nasnetamobile backbones
